title: Synchro-Compur leaf shutter
about: a 29-component reconstruction of a Synchro-Compur 0-MXV camera shutter, rendered in brass, steel and black, and moved in the Render view by the shutter's own dynamics: one 1/125 release, 250 times slower
tries: Open the Render view and play the release | Show the mechanism: set CUTAWAY to true in look.js | Make the blades brass in the Render view's material library

agent.role: a camera-shutter mechanic who knows the Compur repair manual
agent.prompt: Prefer finishes and materials through .material() and .finish() in compur.parts.js; never move a part's placement, because the baked poses in compur-poses.look.js are relative to where each part is drawn; regenerate the poses with tools/compur-poses.mjs rather than editing them.

fragments.poses: Say which simulated body drives each component you change, and whether the poses in compur-poses.look.js still fit it.
